camera.reason: 48MP sensor-shift OIS main plus a 48MP ultrawide and an 18MP Center Stage selfie camera; no telephoto.

performance.reason: Apple A19 on 3nm handles every game at high settings with sustained performance.

battery.reason: 3,692mAh lasts a full day plus and reaches 50% in 20 minutes with a 40W adapter.

display.reason: 6.3 inch LTPO OLED at 1 to 120Hz with 3,000 nits outdoor peak.

build.reason: Aluminium frame, Ceramic Shield 2 front, glass back and IP68 at 6 metres.

software.reason: Apple commits to at least 5 years of security updates (UK PSTI statement) and has historically shipped about 6 major iOS upgrades.

value.reason: At 395,000 with 256GB, 120Hz and two 48MP cameras it undercuts older Pro models and costs the same as iPhone Air.

availability.reason: In stock at Mega.pk and PriceOye with authorised distributor warranty; Daraz's flagship store was out of stock.
